posts.title: social media
posts.description: I’m 54 years old and have NEVER left a nasty comment on anyone’s post. Not on Facebook, Instagram, Threads… nowhere. Don’t like it? I scroll. Disagree? I scroll. Find you annoying? I scroll faster. It’s called minding my own damn business. Apparently, a lost art.

posts.title: Koofr: Cloud Storage Without the Drama
posts.description: I’ve used enough cloud storage services to know how this usually goes. Upload your files. Install the app. Get nagged to upgrade. Decline. Get nagged again. Eventually wonder why a file-storage company needs to know everything about you. Then there’s Koofr.
